name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi–Saudi strikes 9–11 Nov; Gaza aid dispute
summary: Houthi missiles and drones at Riyadh and Saudi oil sites on 9–11 Nov; coalition strikes Sanaa; Gaza ceasefire strained
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on 10 and 11 Nov, after the East-West pipeline in Medina region was hit on 9 Nov; the Houthi-run Saba agency reported coalition airstrikes on a gas facility and oil company building in Sanaa (Al Jazeera, 10 Nov; Reuters via Al-Monitor, 11 Nov). The Houthis said they targeted a Yanbu pumping station, which Saudi Arabia has not confirmed. In Gaza, a UK, Qatar and Jordan-led group of over 50 countries urged Israel to admit winter shelter, fuel and medical supplies (Times of Israel, 13 Nov). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories, and Lebanon. Flights to and from Riyadh can be disrupted at short notice during missile alerts.
rubric_hit: Alert: major cross-border strikes (Houthi missiles at Riyadh 10–11 Nov; coalition strikes on Sanaa)

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on pipeline

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
